script_text: A Uranus shock to your first house strikes Monday, Taurus, rattling your earth element and your stability. Venus, your ruling planet, trines Uranus in your first house Monday, sparking romance and money ideas. But the Sun in Libra squares Mars in your second house Tuesday, making Monday best for cash and Tuesday worst for money fights. The pivot hits Wednesday when Mercury enters Scorpio in your seventh house, turning partnership talk from casual to contract-level serious. A Full Moon in Aries hits your twelfth house Thursday, forcing rest before the weekend, then the Sun edges toward Scorpio by Sunday, lighting your seventh house and pulling you toward marriage, alliances, and one Saturday date. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury in your seventh house seals deals; Thursday drains you under the twelfth-house Full Moon. Book that relationship talk Wednesday morning, then decline overtime Thursday. Follow for daily updates.
